purpose: Alternative methods after initial MLP experiments; development validation comparison, not independent test evidence
input: Same aligned text_bert/audio/vision and official train/valid; same frozen BERT-Mini and masks
features: Per-modality masked mean and standard deviation; observed content fractions. Hybrid adds train-fitted TF-IDF of visible WordPiece unigrams/bigrams without bridging gaps.
train_feature_scaler: Fit on original train only, separately divide each modality block by sqrt(number of features).
augmentation: One clean view weight .4 plus four missing views weight .15 each; missing views single modality probability 2/3, double modality 1/3; blocks .1-.5; text uses same pre-BERT eight-view cache.
regressor_selection: Minimum mean validation MAE across same four conditions and three seeds, within family
classifier_selection: Maximum mean macro-F1 across same four conditions and three seeds; regression MAE breaks ties
final_evaluation: Same 32 conditions; three-seed probability/intensity ensemble compared with old frozen MLP ensemble
forbidden_feedback: No attachment2 test labels; no attachment3 distribution or outputs used for choosing hyperparameters; no external emotion training data.
